notes.title: Remake notice update
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

Today's update is a very small one. The only change is the addition of a button in the main menu that displays a notice about the upcoming remake, just in case anyone missed the announcement.

Other than that, nothing new—but stay tuned!

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.notes:
Hey guys!
The minor update has been released! It includes some small additions, changes and most importantly, fixes! Here's the changelog:

ADDED:
 added a toggle for the camera shake in the pause menu

CHANGED:
 the inventory button in The Lobby is no longer visible until the player picks up the backpack, which also fixes a mouse bug in The Lobby.
 some slight changes to Shoprooms 2

FIXED:
 fixed a softlock issue in the auditorium in The Lobby
 slightly improved performance in Shoprooms 2
 some fixes done for level loading

The next update will include some very interesting features, so stay tuned!

notes.title: Minor update coming out soon
notes.notes:
Hey guys!
So apparently, there are still some issues that need to be sorted out in the game, and there will be an update addressing those issues very soon (and this time, it's actually  is soon). As for the release date, I'm aiming for Christmas, though it might come out earlier!
Additionally, I've been thinking about having a beta branch for the game so that updates can be tested before publishing them, so that the likelihood of issues would be minimized!
Sorry for all of the inconveniences, and stay tuned!

notes.title: Hotfix Update
notes.notes:
Hey guys!
As announced earlier, I've released a hotfix update for the game, which fixes some issues. Here's the list of changes:

ADDED:
 added some decals to level Run For Your Life

CHANGED:
 changed some of the credits
 done some slight changes to Stations

FIXED:
 fixed an issue with the inventory that caused unnatural mouse behavior and inability for the player to move
 fixed an issue where the player would be transported to the Shoprooms if they die in level Run For Your Life
 fixed an issue where the player wouldn’t properly exit to the main menu after the credits ended
 fixed a noclip bug in the disposal area in Shoprooms 2
 fixed an issue where some objects didn’t have collision
 fixed wrong collisions in level Management Threshold

Enjoy!

notes.title: Hotfix releasing soon
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

I've noticed some bugs that need to be patched out, and I will soon release a hotfix!
The bugs in question are:
- most notably a problem with the inventory, where exiting it causes problems with mouse behavior. 
WORKAROUND: when in the inventory, press any other button on the top bar. If the mouse bug is already present, just press Escape twice!
- noclipping in the trash disposal area in Shoprooms 2 when on the edge of the ramp
- If you spot any other issues that greatlyaffect gameplay, let me know and I will also include them in the hotfix!
Sorry for the inconvenience!

notes.title: Major Update
notes.notes:
Hey guys!
Finally, after a few months of work, the update has been released! 
As mentioned earlier, this update is huge, ranging from expanded levels and more items to QoL features and bug fixes!

Here is a list of everything included in the update:


ADDED:

 added bob
 added more inventory items
 added support for Full HD and Quad HD resolution
 added animations for when interacting with objects, such as the flashlight
 you can now use the scroll wheel to swap items in the hotbar, not just the number keys
 added a battery system to the flashlight. The player will now be required to look for batteries so that the flashlight can be used.
 added in-game settings
 added cutscenes which will be played on some levels when the player enters them
 added a list of controls to The Lobby 
 added new levels:

 Shoprooms 2
- A sublevel of Shoprooms, featuring a long, pink corridor
 Stations
- A level resembling an underground railway station, featuring a store and restaurant, as well as an outer area.
 Fallen World
 Habitable Zone
- A level resembling an underground parking area, with wet concrete.
 Pool Heaven
- A level resembling a pool-like area, surrounded by an infinite ocean


 added a help command to the laptop in level Management Hall
 the player can now zoom the camera in and out
 added a Medium graphics preset
 and… more…

CHANGED:
 expanded levels (this includes but is not limited to more areas and some bug fixes):

 The Lobby
 Basement
 Sublimity
 Level 188
 Management Threshold
 Management Hall
 The Lobby 2
 Kitty’s House
 Shoprooms
 Run For Your Life
 THE END is NEaR
 True End


 each level displays its name upon entering it
 The player is no longer required to press the buttons in Sublimity. Only finding the wrench is required as of this update
 made the game replayable by making some levels exclusive to certain exits. This means that some levels can have more than one exit, thus the possibility to end up in a different level
 changed some of the progression mechanics in some of the levels
 made some slight changes to the inventory UI
 improved reflection in the Shoprooms
 moved the console input from the laptop in level Management Hall to the bottom
 added some more buttons to the laptop in level Management Hall
 the credits section in the main menu now has a scrollbar
 slightly improved some models
 revamped the main menu UI
 revamped the pause menu UI
 changed some item textures
 optimized some levels
 changes under the hood

FIXED:

 improved object interaction
 fixed an issue where footstep sounds would often repeat
 made the flashlight in Level 0 less bright
 fixed a rendering glitch in an area in Level 0
 fixed a noclip bug in level Sublimity
 fixed a bug involving function keys
 fixed some bugs related to interacting with the laptop in level Management Hall
 fixed an issue related to slight noclipping when too close to a wall
 fixed some issues related to driving the car in level Synth, like wrong rotations and inaccurate speed
 fixed an issue related to loading save data


REMOVED:
 removed item swapping in the inventory due to numerous issues
 the position of the player is no longer saved and loaded. Only the level and inventory are saved


KNOWN ISSUES:
 some of the audio might not be fully muted when the volume is set to 0. This issue will be fixed in a later update!

Enjoy!

notes.title: Update information
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

I would like to inform you that the upcoming update will likely be postponed to a later time. The reason for this is simply because the update will be huge, so I need some more time to work on it. I am still not exactly sure how long it will take to get it done, so I don't really wanna make any promises. Although I think it would be nice to at least let you all know what's coming, so here are some things that the update will include as of me posting this announcement:

 more levels
 expansion to some of the existing levels
 changes in some of the mechanics
 bug fixes

...and quite a bit more! I am aware that I'm not very specific with what is being changed, but I can assure there is a lot! However, if you would like to take a quick look at some of the new things coming, you can join the  Discord server!

Sorry for the inconveniences, I hope all of you understand!
Stay tuned!

notes.title: Update coming soon
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

I would like to inform you that there will be a significant update coming to the game soon! While it's difficult for me to determine the exact date, I am aiming for not more than 1-3 months! I also do not wanna spoil too much, but I can say there will be quite a few additions to the game!
Stay tuned!

notes.title: Content Update
notes.notes:
Hey guys!
Today I've released a content update for the game! This one includes two new levels aswell as some changes and fixes, aswell as soundtrack! Here's a changelog of everything that has been added, fixed and changed:

ADDED:

 added soundtrack for the main menu
 added two levels: Synth and Aurora, both including a soudtrack
 made the music box in level Kitty's House interactable
 added bob


CHANGED:

 made level Run easier by removing some of the beds
 reduced motion blur in level Run, further making it easier
 fixed an issue where the player would sprint very fast on level Run before the alarm is triggered
 fixed a bug where UI elements in the main menu would overlap with the game selection option


Stay tuned for later updates!

notes.title: Bug fixes and New game option
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

First of all:  sorry for the huge amounts of updates! I promise tomorrow will be the last day where i release daily updates!
Anyways, this update mainly includes some additions to the save system - a seperate option to load the existing game and start a new one! Here's the full list of what's changed:


 Added an option to start a new game or load the existing save file
 Fixed a bug where the player would noclip in the 2nd level by crouching
 Fixed a bug where the player could get behind the lockers in the 3rd level


Stay tuned for the next update!

notes.title: Performance Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

This update includes performance improvements and more settings! Here's everything that I've added:


 Better Performance
 Improved Main Menu UI
 Resolution Settings


In future updates, I will focus on improving the pickup system and make the clues easier to understand!
Stay tuned!

notes.title: Hotfix Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

So, the game has been released now, and I've decided to release a hotfix update. This includes:


 Bug fixes
 Game mechanic changes
 UI Fixes


In the next update, I'm planning on making the game available for mac and Linux, so stay tuned!
